findings.evidence_dynamic: Payload reflected unencoded in response body (special characters intact)
findings.ai_note: REAL. The injected payload <script>alert('XSS')</script> appears in the response with its special characters intact, indicating that the application is not correctly escaping output.
findings.remediation: To remediate the XSS vulnerability, the application should encode user-input data, such as the `firstname` parameter, before reflecting it in the response body. A concrete code-level fix example is to use the `htmlspecialchars()` function in PHP, e.g., `echo htmlspecialchars($_GET['firstname']);`. By doing so, special characters will be encoded, preventing malicious scripts from being executed, and thus mitigating the XSS vulnerability.
